No. 55/1/1/79-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text:
The undersigned is directed to state that with
effect from afternoon of January 26, 1979 -

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text:
(i) Shri Ram Kinkar assumed the office of the
Minister of State in the Ministry of Works and
Housing and Supply and Rehabilitation.

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text:
(ii) Shri Janeshwar Mishra assumed the office of
the Minister of State in the Ministry of Energy.

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text:
(iii) Shri Jagbir Singh assumed the office of the
Minister of State in the Ministry of Information
and Broadcasting.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text:
(iv) Shri Narsingh assumed the office of
the Minister of State in the Ministry of
Petroleum, Chemicals and Fertilizers.

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text: All Members of the Council of Ministers.

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text:
Copy forwarded to the Deputy Chairman, Planning
Commission/ All Members of the Planning Commission.

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text:
Secretary to the President.
Secretary to the Vice-President.

#/texts/15.label: paragraph
#/texts/15.full_gt_text:
Copy forwarded for information to:-
Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister.
Joint Secretary to the Prime Minister.

#/texts/16.label: paragraph
#/texts/16.full_gt_text:
(K. Ramiah)
Under Secretary to the Cabinet.
